# Lucera Global

> Lucera Global is a patient-referral agency that helps international patients choose a licensed, doctor-led hair transplant clinic in Istanbul, Turkey. We review photos, give a free graft estimate, explain what a package includes and support patients on WhatsApp before, during and after their trip. The procedure is performed by our partner clinic; clinics pay us a referral fee.

Key facts:
- Service: free photo review and graft estimate (front, top and crown photos), clinic matching, written quote, ongoing WhatsApp support.
- Location served: Istanbul, Turkey. Patients come from the Middle East, the UK, Europe and beyond.
- Languages: English, Arabic, Turkish.
- Contact: WhatsApp +44 7853 745956 (https://wa.me/447853745956), info@luceraglobal.com
- Our standard: a licensed doctor should design the hairline, harvest the grafts and make the recipient incisions (ISHRS position). We encourage every patient to ask any clinic who performs each step, by name.
- We do not promise guaranteed growth, and we do not present other clinics' before/after photos as our results.
